# MINTA

> MINTA is a launchpad app on VYRE mainnet (chain ID 3045): anyone can launch a token in one transaction, trade it with USDC and explore launches. Gas and trading are in USDC. MINTA is a website; it holds no funds and has no accounts. You sign every transaction in your own wallet.

Site: https://minta.vyrechain.com
Fuller version of this file, with the contract calls: https://minta.vyrechain.com/llms-full.txt
For people: https://minta.vyrechain.com/agents/

## Live facts

- Network: VYRE mainnet, chain ID 3045, mainnet is live. Gas is USDC (the chain's native currency, 18 decimals).
- RPC: https://rpc.vyrechain.com
- Explorer: https://explorer.vyrechain.com
- Add the network to a wallet: https://vyrechain.com/add/
- Moving USDC between VYRE and Arc (chain 5042): a withdrawal to Arc takes about a day.
- Contracts (VyrePadV2, the launchpad): 0x3B3f9098575a88E56a22b9e2f93ea40fA9340bC5. Trades go through the Uniswap v3 SwapRouter at 0x38231F0fa2Bb09Fdb3fD783b110CB5B3a4d3Ad84 (quoter 0x92c33Bef4552fBAb7264A4Da1805743A295FC3FA). Full list in llms-full.txt.

## Launch and trade, in plain steps

1. Add VYRE to a wallet and put USDC in it (https://vyrechain.com/add/).
2. To launch: choose a name, ticker, supply, and a creator tax from 1% to 10% for buys and for sells. One transaction creates the token and its pool. An optional first buy can ride in the same transaction.
3. To trade: buy or sell a token with USDC at https://minta.vyrechain.com, or through the contracts directly (llms-full.txt).
4. The creator collects the tax whenever they like and can split it between up to 4 wallets.

## The fee rule

- The creator's tax is the only fee a trader pays. The creator sets it at launch, from 1% to 10% per side (buy and sell separately), in USDC.
- A creator can lower the tax later, never raise it, and never below 1%.
- When the tax is paid out, the platform takes a tenth of it (10%, to 0x72938Daaf3c2Fa4bEf722E1263a5766755788392) and the creator's tax wallets get the rest.
- No other fee is added to a trade. Every transaction also pays the network fee, in USDC.
- Example: a 1,000 USDC trade with a 5% tax pays 50 USDC of tax; of each payout, one tenth goes to the platform wallet and nine tenths to the creator's tax wallets.

## Using MINTA from an AI assistant or a script

- The assistant prepares a transaction (target contract, call data, USDC value); the user checks it and signs it in their own wallet. Never ask a user for a private key or seed phrase, and never accept one.
- Prepare it with viem and the contract calls in llms-full.txt. Install: npm install https://vyrechain.com/sdk/vyrechain-sdk-0.6.0.tgz viem. The SDK supplies the chain definition (vyreMainnet) and USDC helpers; use the contract addresses on this page, not the SDK's older launchpad entries.
- Read before writing: check launchesOpen() on the launchpad, simulate the call, show the user the amounts, and set a spend limit.
- Token pages are hash routes (https://minta.vyrechain.com/#/token/<token address>) that need JavaScript; to read a launch use the contracts or the explorer.

## Risks

- USDC on VYRE mainnet is real money. Tokens can fall to zero. Transactions cannot be reversed, and a failed transaction still costs its network fee.
